import json,subprocess,sys
targets=[(-1003770334893,x) for x in (4,18,783)]+[(-1002373696859,x) for x in (1695,4291,1724,1723,4672,1)]

 p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"scripts/userbot_topic_audit_client.py","--chat-id",str(chat),"--topic-id",str(topic)],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=125)
